question:
Select the Venn diagram that best illustrates the relationship between the following classes.

Cow, Cheetah, Wild animals
solution:
The correct Venn diagram representation is,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn010.adda247.com/99ecba63-4b13-4557-a817-a8bdab35ad3c.png] 

Cheetah is a subset of Wild Animals → So, Cheetah is inside the Wild Animal circle.**
Cow is completely separate, as it does not belong to Wild Animals.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2"**
